source_refs.note: Roman Urdu solution of the exercise (PDF 223-225, key PDF 226): MCQs with key and reason, short and long answers, Wazahat boxes where needed.

blocks.text: Exercise mein kitab ke 10 multiple choice, 8 short aur 8 long questions hain. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur us ki wajah chapter ke text se di gayi hai; jahan kitab ki answer key text se mel nahi khati wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai. Short aur long sawalon ke jawab imtihan ke andaz mein hain; hisaab wale jawabon mein har qadam likha hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the primary goal of entrepreneurship?
(Entrepreneurship ka asal maqsad (main goal) kya hai?)

options.text: To solve problems and create value

blocks.explanation: Entrepreneurship ka asal maqsad logon ke masle hal karna aur un ke liye value (qadr) paida karna hai (chapter ka introduction aur summary).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which of the following is a principle of Design Thinking?
(In mein se Design Thinking ka principle (usool) kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab Design Thinking ko human-centered approach kehti hai: pehle user ki jagah khud ko rakh kar (empathize) us ki zaroorat samjhi jati hai, phir hal dhoonda jata hai (9.1.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (c) "risks kam karna" deti hai. Kitab Design Thinking ko human-centered approach kehti hai jo empathize se shuru hoti hai, is liye jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. What is the first step in creating a business plan?
(Business plan banane ka pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Business plan pehle business idea batata hai aur phir use kamyab banane ka tareeqa (9.2.1); is liye pehla qadam business idea tay karna hai, market analysis aur forecast baad mein.

blocks.prompt:
4. Which technique is commonly used in Design Thinking?
(Design Thinking mein aam taur par kaunsi technique istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Design Thinking ke Ideate qadam mein brainstorming hoti hai: har mumkin hal socha jata hai, perfect hone ki fikr ke baghair (9.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the purpose of collecting market insights?
(Market insights jama karne ka maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: To understand customer needs and market trends

blocks.explanation: Market insights se target customers, muqabil (competitors) aur market ka pata chalta hai; is se customers ki zarooratein, pasand aur trends samajh aate hain (9.3, 9.3.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (c) "tax ka hisab" deti hai. Kitab market insights ko customers ki zarooraton aur market trends samajhne ka zariya kehti hai (9.3), is liye jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. A successful business pitch should be:
(Kamyab business pitch kaisi honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Business pitch aik mukhtasar presentation hai; is mein masla, hal aur khaasiyat saaf aur qaail karne wale andaz mein batayi jati hai taake support mile (9.3.3-9.3.5).

blocks.prompt:
7. What is a key component of effective marketing?
(Effective (achha asar karne wali) marketing ka aham hissa kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Marketing customers ko khenchti aur brand ko barhati hai (9.4); mazboot brand identity (pehchan) se customer karobar ko pehchanta aur us par bharosa karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Financial concepts for business help entrepreneurs to:
(Karobar ke financial concepts entrepreneurs ki kis cheez mein madad karte hain?)

options.text: Manage resources and plan for growth

blocks.explanation: Revenue, profit, budget, savings aur loan jaise financial concepts se entrepreneur resources ka behtar intezam aur karobar barhane ka plan banata hai (9.5).

blocks.prompt:
9. Which skill is crucial for storytelling in business?
(Karobar mein storytelling ke liye kaunsi skill sab se zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Storytelling alfaaz, tasveeron aur jazbat se kahani bana kar audience ko jorti hai (9.6.2); achhe ads audience se jazbati rishta (emotional connection) banate hain (9.8.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (c) "jismani taqat" deti hai, jis ka storytelling se koi talluq nahi. Text kehta hai storytelling jazbat se audience ko jorti hai (9.6.2), is liye jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. Innovation in business is primarily about:
(Karobar mein innovation asal mein kis bare mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Innovation sirf bilkul nayi cheez ijad karna nahi, balkay maujooda cheezon ko behtar, tez ya zyada mufeed banana bhi hai (9.8.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Key (c) "kharche kam karna" deti hai. Text innovation ko naye ideas aur maujooda products aur processes ki behtari kehta hai (9.8.1), is liye jawab (b) hai. Key mein das sawalon ke liye chaudah (14) jawab chhape hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Define entrepreneurship in your own words.
(Entrepreneurship ki apne alfaaz mein definition (matlab) likhiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Entrepreneurship yani kisi masle ya zaroorat ko pehchanna, naye idea ko aise karobar mein badalna jo woh masla hal kare aur customers ke liye value paida kare, aur use shuru aur chalane ka risk (khatra) lena.
Chapter ke aham points:
1. Is ki bunyad innovation aur creativity hai: naye ideas ya maujooda cheezon ka behtar roop.
2. Is ka maqsad problem-solving aur value creation hai.
3. Is mein Design Thinking, business plan, pitch, marketing aur financial management ki skills lagti hain.
Misal: yeh dekh kar ke shehar ki chhoti dukanon ki websites nahi, un ke liye sasti web development service shuru karna (9.3.4).

blocks.prompt:
2. What is the main focus of Design Thinking?
(Design Thinking ka main focus (asal tawajjo) kis par hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Design Thinking ka asal focus woh log (users) hain jin ka masla hal karna hai: yeh human-centered approach hai jo seedha hal par jaane ke bajaye pehle user ki nazar se masle ko gehrai se samajhti hai (9.1.1).
Is ke paanch qadam: Empathize (user ke jazbat aur zaroorat samajhna), Define (masla saaf likhna), Ideate (hal sochna), Prototype (saada model banana), Test (feedback le kar behtar karna).
Misal: school bag design karne se pehle students se baat karna ke unhein kaisa bag chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
3. List the key steps involved in creating a business plan.
(Business plan banane ke aham qadam likhiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Business plan aik document hai jo business idea, use kamyab banane ka tareeqa aur maqasid tak pohanchne ke qadam batata hai (9.2.1). Business idea tay karne ke baad is ke aham hisse (9.2.2):
1. Executive Summary: karobar aur maqasid ka mukhtasar khulasa.
2. Business Description: products ya services, target customers aur karobar ki khaasiyat.
3. Market Analysis: mumkina customers, un ki zaroorat aur muqabil.
4. Organization and Management: team members aur un ke kaam.
5. Products or Services: jo bech rahe hain us ki khoobiyan aur faide.
6. Marketing and Sales Strategy: customers ko kaise layenge aur rakhenge.
7. Financial Plan: budget, paisa kahan se aur mutawaqqa aamdani.
8. Appendix (agar zaroorat ho).

blocks.prompt:
4. Why is market research important for a new business?
(Naye karobar ke liye market research kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Market research yani us market ke baare mein data jama karna jis mein karobar kaam karta hai (9.3.1). Naye karobar ke liye zaroori hai kyunke:
1. Customers ki zarooratein, pasand aur rawayya pata chalta hai, to sahi products banaye jate hain.
2. Muqabil ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan pata chalti hain, to karobar alag nazar aa sakta hai.
3. Qeemat, dukaan ke auqat aur marketing message tay karne mein madad (log kitna dena chahte hain).
4. Trends aur market segments samajh aate hain aur demand ka andaza hota hai, risk kam hota hai.
Misal: bakery kholne se pehle mohalle mein survey se pata chalta hai log kaunsi cheezein, kab aur kitne paison mein lena chahte hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the importance of a business pitch.
(Business pitch ki ahmiyat samjhaiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Business pitch aik mukhtasar presentation hai jis mein aap apna business idea samjhate hain (9.3.3). Yeh zaroori hai kyunke:
1. Is se woh support (investment, partners, customers) milti hai jo idea ko haqeeqat banane ke liye chahiye (9.3.5).
2. Is mein masla, hal, khaasiyat aur customers saaf aur mukhtasar batane parte hain.
3. Audience ke mutabiq badli ja sakti hai: customers ko batayein ke product kyun pasand ayega; investors ko ke paisa kaise banega.
4. Achhi pitch faisla kun hoti hai: Apple aur Google jaisi companies bhi saada pitch se shuru huin.

blocks.prompt:
6. How can storytelling benefit a business?
(Storytelling karobar ko kaise faida de sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Storytelling yani alfaaz, tasveeron aur jazbat se aisi kahani banana jo audience ko jor le (9.6.2). Karobar ko faida:
1. Customers aur investors ki tawajjo khenchti hai.
2. Mushkil baat asaan ho jati hai, log product samajh lete hain.
3. Message yaad rehta hai.
4. Baat qareeb aur qaail karne wali lagti hai.
5. Customers se jazbati rishta aur mazboot brand banta hai: maqami brands ke creative ads products bechte bhi hain aur dil se bhi jorte hain (9.8.2).

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe one financial concept that is important for business.
(Karobar ke liye zaroori koi ek financial concept bayan kijiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Revenue aur Profit
Revenue (aamdani) woh kul raqam hai jo karobar saman ya services bech kar kamata hai. Profit (munafa) woh raqam hai jo revenue mein se saare kharche (kiraya, tankhwahein, saman ki qeemat) nikal kar bachti hai (9.5.1).
Profit = Revenue - Costs
Misal: Lahore ki dukaan 100 school bags Rs. 500 ke hisaab se bechti hai aur kul kharcha Rs. 30,000 hai.
Revenue = 100 x 500 = Rs. 50,000
Profit = 50,000 - 30,000 = Rs. 20,000
Ahmiyat: profit batata hai ke karobar kamyab hai ya nahi; ise bacha kar ya laga kar (invest) naya saman liya aur karobar barhaya jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hisaab qadam ba qadam: pehle aamdani nikalein: bags ki tadaad x aik bag ki qeemat = 100 x 500 = 50,000. Phir is mein se kul kharcha 30,000 ghata dein: 50,000 - 30,000 = 20,000. Yaad rakhein: revenue hamesha kharcha nikalne se PEHLE ki raqam hai, profit BAAD ki.

blocks.prompt:
8. Why is collaboration important in the entrepreneurial process?
(Entrepreneurship ke process (amal) mein collaboration kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Collaboration yani do ya zyada log ideas, resources aur mehnat share kar ke aik mushtarka maqsad ke liye mil kar kaam karein (9.7.1). Entrepreneurship mein zaroori hai kyunke:
1. Partners apna ilm aur maharat mila kar mushkil masle hal karte hain (9.7.3).
2. Har aik ki khoobi kaam aati hai, maslan aik baking mein maahir aur doosra karobar chalane mein (9.2.3.2).
3. Mil kar kaam karne se naye ideas aur innovative hal nikalte hain (9.8.3).
4. Google Drive jaise collaborative tools se partners aik hi business plan par aik waqt mein kaam aur feedback kar sakte hain.
Misal: science exhibition mein drawing, model banane aur samjhane wale students mil kar akele se behtar model banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Discuss the importance of Design Thinking in developing business solutions. Provide examples of how it can be applied.
(Business solutions banane mein Design Thinking ki ahmiyat bataiye, aur misalon se dikhaiye ke ise kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Design Thinking aik tareeqa hai jo masle ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhna sikhata hai; seedha hal par jaane ke bajaye pehle masla gehrai se samjha jata hai. Yeh human-centered approach hai, paanch qadam (9.1.1):
1. Empathize: users ki jagah khud ko rakh kar un ke jazbat, zaroorat aur mushkilat samajhna (students se un ke bags ke baare mein baat).
2. Define: masla saaf likhna ("Students ko halka, mazboot, khula aur aaraam deh bag chahiye").
3. Ideate: har mumkin hal sochna (extra padding, khane/compartments).
4. Prototype: jaldi se saada model (gatta, kapra ya kaghaz).
5. Test: users se istemal karwa kar feedback lena aur behtar karna.
Business solutions mein ahmiyat:
- Business solutions companies ke masle hal karne, behtar kaam aur taraqqi ke tareeqe hain (9.1.2); Design Thinking yaqeeni banati hai ke yeh woh products aur services hon jo log waqai chahte hain (9.1.3).
- User ke tajurbe par focus se hal asaan (user-friendly) aur market mein kamyab hota hai.
- Prototype aur test se ghaltiyan jaldi aur sasti pakri jati hain, bari investment se pehle.
- Feedback se product behtar hota rehta hai aur karobar customers ki badalti zarooraton ke saath chalta hai.
Misalein:
- Company khana order karne ki app banati hai: users ko samajh kar, mukhtalif designs test kar ke asaan app (9.1.3).
- Grocery store mein saman aksar khatam ho jata hai: masla define kar ke hal, jaise zyada order ya inventory software (9.1.2).
- Customers online shopping karne lage to dukaan home delivery shuru karti hai (9.1.2).
- College mein homework ke liye waqt nahi: classmates se baat (empathize), masla likhna (define), time management ideas (ideate), saada schedule (prototype), doosre students se test.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Design Thinking ke paanch qadam yaad rakhne ka asaan jumla: "Samjho, Likho, Socho, Banao, Aazmao" (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test). Imtihan mein har qadam ke saath kitab ki school bag wali misal likhein, aur aakhir mein business ki aik do misalein (food app, grocery store) de dein.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the process of creating a business plan, and why each step is critical to the success of a new business.
(Business plan banane ka process samjhaiye, aur yeh ke naye karobar ki kamyabi ke liye har qadam kyun zaroori hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Business plan aik document hai jo business idea, use kamyab banane ka tareeqa aur maqasid ke qadam batata hai; yeh karobar shuru aur chalane ka naqsha (map) hai (9.2, 9.2.1).
Process (pehla qadam business idea tay karna; phir plan in hisson mein likha jata hai, 9.2.2):
1. Executive Summary: karobar kya karega, maqasid kya hain aur kaise hasil honge, mukhtasar.
Kyun zaroori: investors jaldi idea samajh lete hain.
2. Business Description: products/services, target customers aur khaasiyat (maslan bazaar ke qareeb taza chai wala chai dhaba).
Kyun zaroori: idea saaf hota hai aur karobar ki khaasiyat nazar aati hai.
3. Market Analysis: customers kaun, un ki zaroorat, muqabil kaun (maslan ilaqe mein pet owners aur doosri pet-sitting services).
Kyun zaroori: sabit hota hai ke demand hai; aisa karobar nahi banta jis ki kisi ko zaroorat na ho.
4. Organization and Management: karobar ka nizam, team aur un ke kaam.
Kyun zaroori: har aik ko apni zimmedari pata hoti hai.
5. Products or Services: khoobiyan aur faide (tuition se grades kaise barhenge).
Kyun zaroori: customer ko faida nazar aata hai.
6. Marketing and Sales Strategy: customers kaise layein aur rakhein (social media, maqami melay).
Kyun zaroori: customers ke baghair sales nahi.
7. Financial Plan: budget, paisa kahan se, mutawaqqa aamdani (maslan saman ke liye $100 kaise jama honge aur kitna kamayenge).
Kyun zaroori: pata chalta hai karobar chal sakega ya nahi; funding ke liye lazmi.
8. Appendix (agar zaroorat ho): mazeed kaghazat.
Digital tools: PlanGuru ya Enloop jaise software templates aur financial projections (sales, cash flow) charts ke saath dete hain; Google Drive ya Dropbox Paper se partners mil kar likhte, comment karte aur versions track karte hain (9.2.3).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Business plan ke hisse yaad rakhne ke liye aik chai dhabay ka socho: kya bechoge (description), kaun khareedega (market), kaun chalayega (management), kya khaas hai (products), log kaise ayenge (marketing), paisa kitna lagega aur kitna ayega (financial). Sab se upar in sab ka khulasa (executive summary) likha jata hai, halanke woh aksar sab se aakhir mein tayyar hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. How does market insight influence business decisions? Give examples of how businesses can use this information.
(Market insight karobari faislon par kaise asar dalti hai? Misalein dijiye ke karobar yeh maloomat kaise istemal kar sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Market insight yani target customers, muqabil aur market ki maloomat jama aur analyze kar ke hasil hone wali samajh. Is se karobar strategy, products aur marketing ke soche samjhe faisle karta hai (9.3).
Maloomat kaise jama hoti hai (9.3.1):
- Qualitative research (interviews, focus groups, mushahida): customers ki wajahein, raaye aur niyyat.
- Quantitative research (surveys): adadi (numerical) data jo patterns aur trends dikhaye, maslan log kitni baar coffee lete hain aur kitna dena chahte hain.
Faislon par asar, misalon ke saath (9.3.2):
1. Trends aur patterns: survey se pata chala ke bakery ki zyada khareed weekend par hoti hai, to marketing aur offers weekend par.
2. Market segmentation: jawan customers meethi pastries, bare umar wale whole-grain bread pasand karte hain, to har group ke liye products aur ads.
3. Competitor analysis: qareebi bakery artisanal bread ke liye mashhoor hai, to hum gourmet pastries ya mausmi cakes shamil karte hain.
4. Predictive analysis: kisi product ki demand musalsal barh rahi hai, to production barhayein ya menu wasee karein.
5. Data-driven decisions: jo product kam bik raha hai use band kar ke kamyab products par tawajjo; data se products, qeemat aur marketing tay hoti hai.
6. Auqat aur products: kholne se pehle mohalle ke survey se pata chalta hai log kya aur kis waqt khareedte hain (9.3.1.2).
Yun market insight risk kam karti hai, customers khush aur sales zyada karti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Market insight ko "customer ki nabz" samjhein. Jaise doctor nabz dekh kar dawa deta hai, waise karobar data dekh kar faisla karta hai: weekend par rush hai to offer weekend par; bachon ko meetha pasand hai to meethi cheezein zyada; muqabil bread mein achha hai to hum cake mein aage barhein. Har faisle ke saath data ki aik misal likhein.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the key elements of an effective business pitch and how to prepare one.
(Effective business pitch ke aham hisse bataiye aur yeh ke pitch kaise tayyar ki jati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Business pitch aik mukhtasar presentation hai jis mein aap apna business idea batate hain (9.3.3).
Achhi pitch ke aham hisse:
1. Idea kya hai (maslan juice shop jo taza, sehat mand aur saste juice bechegi).
2. Customers kaun hain (mohalle ke log jo sehat ka khayal rakhte hain).
3. Kyun chalega (qareeb koi juice shop nahi; log sehat ke baare mein zyada sochne lage hain).
4. Khaasiyat (unique selling point) aur target audience.
Pitch tayyar karne ke qadam (9.3.4):
1. Masle se shuru karein jo aap ka idea hal karega.
2. Apna hal batayein: karobar masla kaise hal karega.
3. Batayein kyun munfarid hai: doosron se behtar kya hai.
4. Audience ko jaanein: customers ko batayein unhein kyun pasand ayega; investors ko ke paisa kaise banega.
5. Sawalon ke liye tayyar rahein, maslan qeemat ya jagah.
Web development service ki pitch ki misal:
- Masla: "Shehar ke bohat se chhote karobar website na hone ki wajah se customers nahi khench paate."
- Hal: "Main in ke liye saadi aur sasti websites banane ki service shuru karunga."
- Khaasiyat: "Chhote karobar ke liye khaas, asaan design aur maqami zaban ki support."
- Target Audience: "Maqami dukandar aur restaurant managers jo online zyada customers chahte hain."
Pesh karne ke tips: saaf aur qaail karne wali, saaf bolna, achhi body language aur aankh se aankh mila kar baat, sawal ghaur se sunna (9.6.1), aur pehle mashq.

blocks.prompt:
5. What are the essential components of a marketing and sales strategy? Discuss how these strategies can be tailored for different markets.
(Marketing aur sales strategy ke zaroori hisse kya hain? Bataiye ke yeh strategies alag alag markets ke liye kaise badli ja sakti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Marketing aur sales karobar ko customers, zyada sales aur brand ki taraqqi dete hain (9.4).
Zaroori hisse:
1. Market ko samajhna: mumkina customers, un ki zaroorat aur product us zaroorat ko kaise poora karega (9.4.1). Misal: rawayati Pakistani kapre Eid ya shadi ki tayyari karne walon ke liye.
2. Marketing plan: target market tak pohanchne ki strategies aur channels, jaise social media, TV ya zubani tashheer (word-of-mouth) (9.4.2). Misal: naya masala brand cooking shows par ad ya food influencers ke saath kaam.
3. Sales strategies: customer ko khareedne par aamada karne ke tareeqe: discount, promotions aur behtareen customer service (9.4.3). Misal: Ramzan mein khane ki cheezon par deals se log zyada khareedte hain.
4. Customer ki zaroorat samajhna: aise products jo zaroorat poori karein (9.4.4). Misal: Karachi mein water purifier garmiyon mein saaf pani ki zaroorat par focus.
Mukhtalif markets ke liye tabdeeli:
- Mausam aur mauqa: Ramzan aur Eid mein ads barhana; shadiyon ke mausam mein jewellery par mehdood waqt ke discount.
- Customer group: umar, aamdani ya khareedne ki aadat ke mutabiq products aur message (jawanon ke liye meethi pastries, bare umar walon ke liye whole-grain bread, 9.3.2).
- Jagah aur zaroorat: Karachi mein purifier ko garmiyon ke pani ke masle se jorna.
- Online market: Lahore ka start-up handmade jewellery Instagram, Facebook aur influencers se bechta hai; Pakistan mein e-commerce barh raha hai, online marketing bohat zyada logon tak pohanchti hai.
- Rawayati market: TV, cooking shows aur zubani tashheer un logon tak jo online nahi.

blocks.prompt:
6. Explain the significance of financial management in a business. How do financial concepts such as budgeting and cash flow affect business operations?
(Karobar mein financial management (paise ka intezam) ki ahmiyat samjhaiye. Budgeting aur cash flow jaise concepts karobar ke kaam par kaise asar dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Financial management yani karobar ke paise ki planning aur nigrani. Financial concepts samajhna zaroori hai; is se behtar faisle hote hain aur karobar barhta hai (9.5).
Aham concepts aur karobar par asar:
1. Revenue aur profit (9.5.1): revenue bikri ki kul raqam; profit = revenue - kharche.
Misal: 100 bags x Rs. 500 = Rs. 50,000 revenue; profit = 50,000 - 30,000 = Rs. 20,000. Profit batata hai karobar kamyab hai ya nahi.
2. Expenses aur budgeting: expenses chalane ke kharche (kiraya, bijli pani, tankhwahein, kacha maal); budget andaza lagata hai ke har hisse ko kitna paisa chahiye.
Misal: Rawalpindi bakery ka mahana budget = 200,000 + 150,000 + 250,000 + 150,000 = Rs. 750,000. Budget ko asal kharche se mila kar pata chalta hai ke zyada kharch ho raha hai ya bachat, aur kharche qaboo mein rehte hain.
3. Investment aur savings (9.5.2): investment mustaqbil ke munafe ke liye paisa lagana (Rs. 50,000 ka naya saman); savings aage ki zaroorat ke liye paisa rakhna (Rs. 10,000 mahana x 12 = Rs. 120,000 saal mein, naye oven ke liye).
4. Loans aur interest (9.5.3): loan udhaar paisa hai jo interest (sood, udhaar ki qeemat) ke saath wapas hota hai.
Misal: Rs. 100,000 par 10% salana: kul wapsi = 100,000 + 10,000 = Rs. 110,000. Rs. 50,000 par 8%: 50,000 + 4,000 = Rs. 54,000. Rate zyada to wapsi zyada.
5. Cash flow (chapter se bahar; kitab ka business plan software cash flow projections banata hai): waqt ke saath karobar mein aane aur jaane wala paisa. Positive cash flow se kiraya, tankhwah, suppliers aur qist waqt par; negative cash flow mein udhaar ya kharcha kam karna parta hai. Budget aur cash flow ka andaza paisa khatam hone se bachata hai.
Ahmiyat: achha financial management karobar ko hamwar chalata, kharche qaboo karta, taraqqi ka plan banata aur funding ke liye tayyar karta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hisaab dobara dekhein: (1) Revenue = 100 x 500 = 50,000; profit = 50,000 - 30,000 = 20,000. (2) Budget = 200,000 + 150,000 + 250,000 + 150,000 = 750,000. (3) Savings = 10,000 x 12 maheene = 120,000. (4) Loan: 10% of 100,000 = 100,000 x 10/100 = 10,000, to kul 110,000; 8% of 50,000 = 4,000, to kul 54,000. Cash flow ko ghar ka hisaab samjhein: tankhwah aane se pehle bill aa jaye to mushkil hoti hai, chahe saal ka kul hisaab theek ho.

blocks.prompt:
7. Discuss the role of communication and storytelling in building a brand and connecting with customers.
(Brand banane aur customers se jurne mein communication aur storytelling ka kirdar bataiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Communication yani doosron se maloomat, ideas ya jazbat ka tabadla; yeh verbal (bolna, likhna) ya non-verbal (ishare, chehre ke taasurat) hota hai. Storytelling alfaaz, tasveeron aur jazbat se aisi kahani banana hai jo audience ko jor le (9.6.1, 9.6.2).
Brand banane aur customers se jurne mein communication ka kirdar:
1. Saaf bolne se karobar ka paigham asaani se samajh aata hai.
2. Achhi body language (ishare, aankh se aankh, aitmaad) se bharosa banta hai.
3. Customers ke sawal aur feedback sunna dikhata hai ke karobar ko un ki parwah hai, aur behtari aati hai.
Storytelling ka kirdar:
1. Achhi kahani tawajjo khenchti, mushkil baat asaan karti aur paigham yaad rakhwati hai.
2. Baat qareeb aur qaail karne wali lagti hai, jaise plastic bags par debate mein apni aankhon dekhi kahani.
3. Jazbati rishta banta hai: maqami brands ke ads products bechte bhi hain aur audience se dil ka rishta bhi jorte hain, jis se mazboot brand identity banti hai (9.8.2).
4. Kahaniyan sadiyon se Pakistani saqafat ka hissa hain (Heer Ranjha, Sassi Punnu), is liye log in se jaldi jurte hain.
Yeh skills kaise barhayein (9.6.3): roz mashq; audience ko jaanein; visual aids; saaf aur mukhtasar; awaaz aur chehre se jazbat dikhayein.
Misal: juice shop batati hai ke woh maqami kisanon se phal leti hai; sehat aur apne ilaqe ki fikr karne wale customers is kahani se jurte hain aur brand yaad rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. How do collaboration and iteration contribute to the success of an entrepreneurial venture? Provide examples of how these processes work in practice.
(Collaboration aur iteration naye karobar ki kamyabi mein kaise hissa dalte hain? Misalein dijiye ke yeh dono asal mein kaise kaam karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Collaboration yani do ya zyada log ideas, resources aur mehnat share kar ke mushtarka maqsad ke liye mil kar kaam karein (9.7.1). Iteration yani kisi amal ko baar baar dohrana taake matlooba nateeje ke qareeb pohanchein; har baar feedback se tabdeeli aur behtari, yahan tak ke aakhri nateeja mil jaye (9.7.2).
Naye karobar ki kamyabi mein hissa (9.7.3):
1. Collaboration se ilm aur maharat jurti hai aur mushkil masle hal hote hain; har partner apni khoobi deta hai.
2. Mil kar kaam se naye ideas aur innovative hal nikalte hain (9.8.3).
3. Iteration se kaam har qadam par behtar hota hai; feedback se ghaltiyan durust hoti hain.
4. Dono mil kar behtar nateeja dete hain aur sab aik doosre se seekhte hain.
Amli misalein:
- Business plan: bakery ke partners Google Drive ya Dropbox Paper mein aik hi plan par kaam karte hain; aik products likhta hai, doosra marketing aur financial hissa; comments, suggestions aur version control se drafts behtar hote hain (9.2.3.2).
- Design Thinking: prototype users se test, feedback, phir behtari, baar baar (9.1.1).
- Logo design: pehla design dikhaya, rang aur shakal badli, phir dikhaya, yahan tak ke sab maan jayein (9.7.2).
- Science exhibition: aik drawing, aik model aur aik samjhane wala; mil kar akele se behtar project (9.7.1).
- Mohalle ki safai muhim: mil kar plan, phir kaam lamba ho ya zyada volunteers chahiye hon to plan badalna (iterate), yahan tak ke ilaqa saaf ho jaye (9.7.3).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Farq yaad rakhein: collaboration = "mil kar" kaam (kaun kaun), iteration = "baar baar behtar" kaam (kitni dafa). Aik startup mein dono saath chalte hain: team mil kar product banati hai (collaboration), customers ki raaye le kar use dobara aur behtar banati hai (iteration).
